summary: Livant’s first-property configuration should center on conventional multifamily leasing, property-specific applications, transparent quoting, cross-property staff access, automated receivables and delinquency workflows, and QuickBooks handoff. Several operational policies still need confirmation because the calls were sales demonstrations rather than implementation decisions. The latest call narrowed the initial scope: accounts payable and maintenance remain in Livant’s existing systems for now.

callsUsed.title: Call with Livant - Jamal Kasham
callsUsed.brief: Oscar from Entrata qualified Jamal as a lead managing 260 units, including multifamily and commercial properties, currently using Buildium and Tenant Cloud. Jamal confirmed upcoming projects in 2024 and is interested in a property management demo, scheduled for 2 PM today. Oscar will tailor the demo to Jamal's workflow and needs, focusing solely on property management features.

callsUsed.title: Meet with Sabrina Olson
callsUsed.brief: Sabrina from Entrata, along with Adam from Livant, discussed Livant's need for a consolidated property management platform to support their growing portfolio of multifamily housing. Livant is seeking a scalable, all-in-one solution to replace their current disparate systems, with a target of switching platforms within 60 days. Entrata's advanced technology and AI capabilities were highlighted as key attractions, and next steps include a deeper dive with a sales representative and tailored demos.

callsUsed.title: Entrata / Livant
callsUsed.brief: Dallin from Entrata, along with Adam from Livant, discussed Entrata's all-in-one property management solution as a potential fit for Livant's growing needs, particularly their recent expansion and desire for integrated software. The conversation focused on Entrata's capabilities in leasing, resident management, and AI features, with a scheduled follow-up meeting to demonstrate the lead-to-lease process and syndication. Entrata aims to provide a comprehensive platform that can optimize Livant's operations and support their future growth plans.

callsUsed.title: Entrata & Livant - Lead to Lease / Lunch Demo
callsUsed.brief: Dallin and Megan from Entrata, along with Adam from Livant, discussed Entrata's comprehensive property management platform, highlighting its capabilities in leasing automation, AI-driven resident communication, integrated marketing tools, and customizable website development. Key features demonstrated included automated workflows for lead-to-lease progression, advanced AI agents for resident interaction and task management, robust marketing analytics, and a user-friendly resident portal with community engagement features. The conversation also touched upon integrations with third-party systems like Ubiquity for access control and the potential for enhanced revenue through services like deposit alternatives and renters insurance.

callsUsed.title: Entrata & Livant - Resident Experience Demo
callsUsed.brief: Megan and Dallin from Entrata, along with Adam from Livant, discussed Entrata's comprehensive property management software, highlighting its capabilities in utility management, resident experience features like a resident portal and AI-driven communication, and robust maintenance and make-ready workflows. Key areas of focus included streamlining resident interactions, automating tasks, and providing detailed reporting, with Entrata offering extensive customization and integration options. The conversation also touched upon Entrata's AI solutions, implementation support, and future development, with a follow-up accounting meeting scheduled to explore specific financial reporting needs.

callsUsed.title: Entrata & Livant - Accounting Demo
callsUsed.brief: Megan and Dallin from Entrata, along with Adam from Livant, discussed Entrata's AI capabilities, accounting features, and vendor management. Key highlights included Entrata's GAAP compliance, customizable reporting, automated workflows for invoicing and payments, and robust vendor compliance tracking. The conversation also covered Entrata's bill pay service, bank reconciliation, journal entry processes, and a potential integration for displaying listings across multiple communities on Livant's website. Pricing and implementation timelines were also reviewed, with a scoping call scheduled for the following week.

callsUsed.title: Livant & Entrata- Questions
callsUsed.brief: Megan and Dallin from Entrata, along with Adam from Livant, discussed Entrata's property management software, focusing on its comprehensive features for leasing, resident experience, and operational management. Livant expressed interest in Entrata's capabilities, particularly its integrated platform and AI-driven tools, but raised concerns about pricing compared to competitors. Entrata presented a discounted offer, including waived setup fees and a reduced monthly per-unit cost, to address Livant's concerns and secure a partnership.
